lessons.culture: In Morocco the bank is called البانكة and the cash machine الديستريبيتور. You show your national ID card (الكارطة الوطنية) to open an account, and the clerk will ask for your signature (الإمضاء). Prices and fees are in dirhams, and cash is still common for daily shopping.

challenge.title: A Morning of Errands
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines in which you withdraw cash at the bank, ask where the post office is, ask how much it costs to send a parcel, and top up your phone credit. Use at least 8 phrases from Unit 19.
required_elements: A request at the bank with بغيت, such as بغيت نجبد شوية دْيال الفلوس.
A question about the post office with فين.
A question about a price with شحال.
A request to top up the phone credit with نعمر الكريدي.
A polite word such as عافاك or شكرا بزاف.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُم. بْغِيت نْجْبَد خَمْسْمْيَة دِرْهَم مْن الْحْسَاب دْيَالِي.
dialogue.transliteration: as-salaamu 3alaykom. bghit njbed khamsmiya dirham mn l7saab dyaali.
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. I want to withdraw five hundred dirhams from my account.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام. عَافَاك، عْطِينِي الْكَارْطَة الْوَطَنِيَّة.
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. Please give me your national ID card.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Here you are. And where is the post office, please?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.english: At the end of the street, next to the phone shop.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: بْغِيت نْصِيفَط كُولِي لْبْلَادِي. شْحَال خَاصّْنِي نْخَلّْص؟
dialogue.transliteration: bghit nSeefeT koli l blaadi. sh7aal khaSSni nkhelleS?
dialogue.english: I want to send a parcel to my country. How much do I have to pay?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: حَطّْو فَالْمِيزَان. تْلَاتَة كِيلُو، مْيَة وْعَشْرِين دِرْهَم.

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.arabic: وَاخَّا. وْبْغِيت نْعَمّْر الْكْرِيدِي دْيَالِي، فِين نْقْدَر نْدِيرْ هَادْشِي؟
dialogue.transliteration: waakha. w bghit n3ammer lkreedi dyaali, fin nqder ndeer haadshi?
dialogue.english: Okay. And I want to top up my credit, where can I do that?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.arabic: فَمَحَلّ التِّيلِيفُون اللِّي قُدَّامَك. هَادِيك هِيَ.
dialogue.transliteration: f ma7all ttilifoon lli qeddaamek. haadik hiya.
dialogue.english: At the phone shop in front of you. That's the one.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.english: Welcome. How much do you want to put in?

dialogue.speaker: Hamza
dialogue.english: Fifty dirhams, please. Thank you very much.
